model.about: Inputs to LOOM's profile optimiser. Power and thermal numbers come from the iQOO 15 runs of 10 Oct 2026 (live_logs/, unplugged, airplane mode). 'source' says how each number was obtained.

thermal.model: dh/dt = a*P - b*(h - h_idle)   (h = Android thermal headroom, P = battery draw in mA)
thermal.source: least-squares fit, 117 one-minute windows from 2,257 s of unplugged runs (quantum/calibrate.py)

base_power_mA.source: measured: median battery draw with every chiplet at HIGH, 1,008 s (Fixed run)

Display.source: power: small — measured effect within noise (±100 mA); quality: a blind user does not rely on the screen

Inference.source: power: measured pairs (1,056 → 927 mA lite2→lite0 GPU; CPU 183 mA above GPU at the same settings); fps: measured latency 72 / ~48 / 81 ms; quality: COCO mAP 34.0 (Lite2) vs 25.7 (Lite0)

Capture.source: power: measured (950 → 742 → 616 mA at 30 / 15 / 10 FPS) and regression; quality: slower reaction to moving objects

Narrator.source: power: measured pair 616 → 586 mA (3 s → 6 s), pause estimated; quality: speech is the product for a blind user

model.check: all-HIGH predicts 1,050 mA (measured 1,056); lite0/GPU only 920 (927); 8% + lite0 + 15/s 710 (742); 8% + lite0 + 10/s 600 (616); + speech 6 s 570 (586)
